name: collection-progress-none-guard
title: collection_progress 缺 isinstance 守卫致 None 响应崩溃
description: app/agent/client/actions/collection_progress.py:44,65 裸调 data.get；HttpBusinessGateway.request 在 Java 成功但 data 为 null 时显式 return None（business_http.py:68），触发 AttributeError。同目录其它 5 个模块均用 isinstance(data, dict) and data.get(...) 守卫。修复后 tests/agent/test_collection_progress.py 的 2 条 xfail(strict) 应转绿。
creator: zhaizzH
